events.headline: TEHRAN TARGETS US GULF BASES AFTER AMERICAN FORCES LAUNCH NEW STRIKES ON IRAN
events.detail: US Central Command says its latest round of strikes were in response to "unwarranted and continued aggression" from Iran.

events.headline: IRAN ANNOUNCES CLOSURE OF STRAIT OF HORMUZ FOLLOWING US STRIKES
events.detail: Iranian officials say the Strait of Hormuz has been closed in response to US strikes.

events.headline: IRAN WAR LIVE: TEHRAN TARGETS BAHRAIN, KUWAITI BASES AFTER NEW US STRIKES
events.detail: Iran remains defiant amid US attacks, orders complete closure of Strait of Hormuz to all vessels.

events.headline: IRAN ATTACKS BAHRAIN, KUWAIT AND SHIPS IN HORMUZ AFTER NEW US STRIKES
events.detail: Tehran claims drone strikes on bases in Bahrain and Kuwait, as US strikes Qeshm Island and ports along Hormuz.

events.headline: TRUMP’S CLAIM OF ESCORTING OIL THROUGH HORMUZ WON’T EASE CRISIS
events.detail: Trump’s claim of escorting oil through Hormuz won’t ease crisis

events.headline: UKRAINE SAYS MISSILES HIT MILITARY PLANT DEEP INSIDE RUSSIA
events.detail: Ukraine's military also says it has struck a Russian oil refinery and a "shadow fleet" oil tanker in the Black Sea.
